reviewed_by: Codex focused review for macOS native Browser containment
reason: The changed journey is the macOS native Browser page inside its visible surface, including resize and Text size. Two exact Rust cases cover main-webview frame coordinates and CSS-to-AppKit zoom conversion. The selected desktop Browser journey covers creating a tab, native bounds updates, resizing, sidebar and research panels, and hiding or revealing the page. macOS CI compiles the AppKit NSClipView integration and runs the selected native cases.
exclusions: No Python or frontend source or server state changed, so Python and component tests are excluded. Mobile clients use the separate web-browser fallback; no mobile behavior changed. Real-Core persistence and non-loopback origin behavior are unchanged. The mocked desktop browser and Linux Rust tests cannot prove macOS WKWebView compositing; a rebuilt Mac app visual and input check is still required before claiming full acceptance. Unrelated suites are excluded.
